fields.Name: T1p -> S-T.2
fields.Description: Gate G2.12 (phase 2, dataset T1p, criterion S-T.2): over ≥ 5 rolling origins at the declared horizon, the shipped model's MASE is ≤ 0.5401, the reference's upper bound (reference 0.4401 [0.3646, 0.5401]; PS 0.9583 today), and it beats seasonal naïve with a paired lower bound > 0. It fails when the rolling-origin holdout uses a random split: the origins' test windows are drawn by a seeded permutation of the holdout periods (the MASE leaves the reference's 0.4401).

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: The shipped model's rolling-origin MASE is at most 0.5401 and beats seasonal naive with a paired lower bound above 0; a row manifest disagreeing with the design is refused; the Ljung-Box veto uses the declared alpha (3 of 3 pytest cases pass).
